title: Étale set-sheaf sections are determined by geometric germs
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $G$ a sheaf of sets on its small étale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], $U\to X$ an object of that site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and $a,b\in G(U)$. Suppose for every algebraically closed field $\Omega$ (in the universe of the schemes), every geometric point $x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ [def-weil-geometric-point], and every lift $z:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to U$ over $x$, the germs of $a$ and $b$ at $(U,z)$ in $G_x$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] agree. Then $a=b$. The statement applies to sheaves of sets in the next universe as in the Lean signature.

source.place: Theorem 03PU (theorem-exactness-stalks), injectivity criterion and its local-neighbourhood argument

proof.text: For each point v of U choose an algebraic closure of its residue field and the resulting geometric point t of U over v, hence a pointed neighbourhood of x = t followed by U → X.

The hypothesis gives equality of the two germs at this neighbourhood. Use Point.toPresheafFiber_eq_iff\prime, the filtered-colimit equality criterion for the cofiltered pointed-neighbourhood category, to obtain m:V→U and a geometric lift w with equal restrictions of a and b. Evaluating the pointed-neighbourhood equation at the point of Spec Ω shows that the image of w lies over v.

The family of these arrows m, indexed by the points of U, is jointly surjective, hence generates an étale covering sieve (Scheme.ofArrows_mem_smallEtaleTopology_iff). Apply the sheaf hom_ext_ofArrows theorem to the two constant PUnit-valued morphisms given by a and b, using the equal restrictions; evaluate the resulting equality at PUnit.unit. Empty U gives the empty-cover instance of the same argument.

from.place: proof, invocation of 09ZF; within its use of 09Z3, injectivity of finite surjective section pullback, checked on germs

lean.statement:
theorem etaleSetSection_ext_of_geometric_germs
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (U : X.Etale) (a b : G.obj.obj (op U))
    (h : ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
      (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X) (z : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale x).fiber.obj U),
      (Scheme.pointSmallEtale x).toPresheafFiber U z G.obj a =
        (Scheme.pointSmallEtale x).toPresheafFiber U z G.obj b) : a = b

split_report: Proved in Lean from local equality in pointed étale neighbourhoods and sheaf separatedness; this is not a restatement of finite surjective descent.
